div.div: Ember — Progressive Telemetry Tiers
Each tier adds a new data dimension. Start with manifest analytics, grow into full observability.

switch.text: Each tier adds a new data dimension. Start with manifest analytics, grow into full observability.

div.div: Tier 0 — Operational Events (exists today)

Forge already emits operational telemetry: sync events, duration, success/failure, file counts. Stored in ~/.crucible/forge/telemetry/ as JSONL.
Answers:“Is Forge working? When was last sync? How often does sync fail?”

text.tspan: Forge already emits operational telemetry: sync events, duration, success/failure, file counts. Stored in ~/.crucible/forge/telemetry/ as JSONL.
Answers: “Is Forge working? When was last sync? How often does sync fail?”

div.div: Tier 1 — Forge Compiler Manifest (Ember v0.1-v0.2)

forge.manifest.json
skills, versions, hashes,
agents, token estimates

v0.1 — Single Project
Read manifest, compute
metrics, CLI report

v0.2 — Fleet View
Multi-project discovery,
version drift, adoption
Answers:“Which skills per project? Which versions? Budget utilization? Version drift across 20 projects?”

switch.text: Answers: “Which skills per project? Which versions? Budget utilization? Version drift across 20 projects?”

div.div: Tier 1.5 — OTLP Export + Grafana (Ember v0.3)

OTLP Metrics Push
crucible.ember.skills.deployed
crucible.ember.tokens.total

Grafana Dashboard Pack
4 pre-built dashboards.
Import and go.

Company Backends
Grafana / DataDog / OTLP collector
Answers:“Same data, in your existing dashboards. No new tool to learn.”

switch.text: Answers: “Same data, in your existing dashboards. No new tool to learn.”

div.div: Tier 2 — LLM Cost Correlation (Ember v0.4)

Langfuse Import
LLM trace data.
Cost per session.

Helicone Import
LLM proxy logs.
Request-level data.

Correlator
Match LLM cost to
skill version by time window
Answers:“Skill X v2.1 costs 40% more than v2.0. Team Alpha spends 3x more than Team Beta.”

switch.text: Answers: “Skill X v2.1 costs 40% more than v2.0. Team Alpha spends 3x more than Team Beta.”

div.div: Tier 3 — Activation Detection (Ember v0.5+)
Ingest native agent telemetry (Claude Code OTEL, Cline logs). Confirm which skills were actually activated, not just deployed.

switch.text: Ingest native agent telemetry (Claude Code OTEL, Cline logs). Confirm which skills were actually activated, not just deployed.
